functions.description: Parse RFC5424 syslog envelope: priority, timestamp, host, and vSAN trace message
Extract vSAN subsystem/module name and detail text from the message
Extract peer/source IPv4 or IPv6 address (and optional port) from message text when present
Derive numeric syslog severity, human-readable severity label, and normalized action from module/detail text

add.name: action
add.value: detail && detail.match(/rejected|blocking|Unauthorized|violation/) ? 'blocked' : detail && detail.match(/completed successfully|resolving|initiated|reconnect attempt/) ? 'recovering' : detail && detail.match(/lost quorum|inaccessible|data loss|stalled|failure|PDL/) ? 'degraded' : 'informational'

add.name: protocol
add.value: module === 'RDT' ? 'vsan-rdt' : module && module.startsWith('DOM') ? 'vsan-dom' : module === 'CMMDS' ? 'vsan-cmmds' : module === 'LSOM' ? 'vsan-lsom' : module === 'CLOM' ? 'vsan-clom' : 'vsan'
